1.why: Headings and body copy use a clean sans-serif with comfortable line height, but letter spacing is default and the small monospace Logs text is not especially generous.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs appear anywhere; all text is short sentence-case snippets.

3.why: The single-column card reads well at mobile width, but the dark Logs panel overflows the card's left and right edges, breaking the layout.

4.why: Every instruction is a single line of plain language, e.g. 'Confirm your account details before setting up payment security.'

5.why: The placeholders 'marcus@example.com' and '+15551234567', reinforced by the helper note, show exactly what the expected input should look like.

6.why: No screen requires reading more than a few short lines; there are no long blocks of text anywhere.

7.why: No secrets, backup codes, or copy buttons appear in any screenshot, so any long code would have to be typed by hand.

8.why: The authenticator setup screen never appears (step 3 repeats the login page), so no QR code or equivalent alternative is offered.

9.why: Only plain email and phone text inputs exist; there is no password or OTP field and no visible autofill or password-manager support.

10.why: The 'Sign in to continue' heading and large blue Continue button stand out clearly, but there is no progress indicator locating this step within MFA enrolment.

11.why: Each screen requests a single action via one Continue button with no competing actions.

12.why: After Continue the only feedback is the vague banner 'We could not complete that request. Please try again,' which does not plainly state what happened or what comes next.

13.why: The Continue button stays enabled and the error invites retrying with no lockout, although no reveal, hide, or re-request controls for codes exist.

14.why: The error avoids blaming the user ('We could not…') but never states the actual problem or how to fix it beyond 'try again.'

15.why: No countdown or reading time limit is visible on any screen, but the flow never reaches code entry, so generous code-entry time cannot be confirmed.
